name: @wgtechlabs/mdd
description: Build and host documentation from Markdown with mdd-engine

scripts.lint: biome check src tests assets scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src tests assets scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.demo: bun run build && node dist/cli.js build --project examples/basic --out ../../mdd-dist --base-path /docs/ && node dist/cli.js serve --out mdd-dist --port 4173 --host 127.0.0.1
